pages.text: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks brings back the classic RPG spellcasting fantasy — staffs, scrolls, arcane essence, and nine schools of magic with real mechanical depth.$(br2)Your $(bold)mana bar$() appears near your hunger bar when you're casting or below full. It regenerates passively over time.

$(bold)Casting:$() Equip a spellbook in mainhand or offhand, right-click to cast. Scroll while holding to cycle spells, or open the spell wheel (tilde key by default).$(br2)$(bold)Acquiring spells:$() Loot chests for scrolls and spellbooks. Craft scrolls at a $(bold)Scroll Forge$() (iron + paper + arcane essence). Upgrade spell tier at an $(bold)Arcane Anvil$().

$(bold)Early gear:$() The $(bold)Wandering Magician$() set is a strong early pick for magic builds — pieces appear in village chests and dungeon loot. Improves spell power and mana regeneration.$(br2)$(bold)Mana regen:$() Passive and constant — standing still does not accelerate it. Design your combat around spell cooldowns and mana efficiency, not waiting for refills.
